diagnostics.title: Report views, config keys and translation keys that don't exist

reportMissingRoutes.title: Also report route names that aren't defined in routes/ (packages add routes the plugin can't see)

locale.title: Main locale: its translations are the ones shown and navigated to

publicDirectory.title: Public directory that asset() paths start from (project-relative)

reportUnknownComponents.title: Report <x-…> Blade components that have no file or class

reportUnknownLivewire.title: Report <livewire:…> components that have no class or view

reportUnknownLivewireDirectives.title: Report @livewire('…') components that have no class or view

reportUnknownInertiaPages.title: Report Inertia pages that have no file under resources/js/Pages

reportUnknownFactories.title: Report Model::factory() calls of models without a factory

checkEloquent.title: Report mass assignment of unguarded models, unscheduled prunable models and orderBy() on date columns that latest() or oldest() replace

checkFunctions.title: Report env() calls outside the config directory (they return null once the configuration is cached)
